items.title: ‘Triplets of Belleville’ Director Sylvain Chomet Fires Back at AI Accusations Over Dior Film Featuring Robert Pattinson’s Voice: ‘Everything Was Drawn by Hand’ (EXCLUSIVE)
items.excerpt: Sylvain Chomet publicly denies using generative AI in his Dior holiday short narrated by Robert Pattinson, insisting everything was drawn by hand - the director's own statement after the allegations.

items.title: Chomet Denies AI Use In Dior Ad, Cites 'Automated Interpolation'
items.excerpt: Chomet insists the Dior ad was hand-drawn but acknowledges 'automated interpolation' was used for in-betweens, reframing where the line between AI and animation tooling sits.

items.title: AI Filmmaking Platform Core Studio Launches at Taiwan Creative Content Fest With 24 Specialized Agents
items.excerpt: Taiwan's imCore launches Core Studio at TCCF, an AI filmmaking platform with 24 specialized agents covering script development through production, running its own image model plus outside generative models.

items.title: Hollywood Has Flipped on GenAI, Says ‘Avatar’ VFX House Weta FX Chief: ‘If You Don’t Have an AI Strategy, Don’t Bother’
items.excerpt: Weta FX CEO Daniel Seah says Hollywood studios have flipped to actively pursuing generative AI: 'If you don't have an AI strategy, don't bother.'

items.title: Weta CEO Daniel Seah Unpacks TAICCA Partnership
items.excerpt: Weta FX CEO Daniel Seah details the TAICCA pact: an investment in Taiwan's Moonshine Studio, developing AI tech and training talent to use it across production, post and VFX.

items.title: Grimes is going to star in an AI movie that’s coming to theaters
items.excerpt: Grimes lends her likeness and voice to 'Gods Don't Give Gifts', a fully AI-generated feature heading to U.S. theaters Dec. 4.

items.title: AI Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Hopes to Tap YouTube Following — and Grimes — for Breakout Moment
items.excerpt: AI feature 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' bets on its creator's YouTube following and a Grimes cameo for a theatrical breakout.

items.title: AI Movie ‘Gods Don’t Give Gifts’ Gets Serious with AI-Generated Grimes Cameo, Times Square Marketing Push, Oscar Screenings
items.excerpt: 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' adds an AI-generated Grimes cameo, a Times Square marketing push and Oscar-qualifying screenings.

items.title: View Conference’s AI Sales Pitches Were Exhausting
items.excerpt: A reporter's account of View Conference: inspiring craft talks, but exhausting generative-AI sales pitches insisting every animation studio already uses AI.

items.title: China’s First AI Feature Earns Just $253,000 In 11 Days
items.excerpt: China's first AI-generated feature 'Sanxingdui: Future Past' reaches only $253,000 after 11 days despite 10,000+ opening-day screenings.
